description: This Java class LocaleUtils provides utility methods to handle locale-related operations such as retrieving Locale objects based on language or store information, and extracting language preferences from HTTP requests within a web shop application.

classes.name: LocaleUtils
classes.description: Utility class for handling locale-related operations in a web shop environment.

methods.name: getLocale
methods.description: Creates a Locale object based on a Language entity using its language code.

methods.name: getLocale
methods.description: Creates a Locale object for currency formatting only using the store’s currency code, matching it to available locales.

methods.name: getRequestLanguage
methods.description: Extracts the Language preference from an HTTP request, defaulting to the store’s default language if not explicitly set.
